root_causes.title: Time-bomb and Ratchet Bugs in check_approval_flag.py
root_causes.description: Two bugs in #300: a time-bomb in check_approval_flag.py where equals-form rejection runs before the exemption check, causing the alias file to fail after the deadline; and a ratchet bug where the assertion uses <= instead of ==, allowing the count to drift without tightening the limit.
root_causes.solution_summary: Move the _EXEMPT_PATHS check before the equals-form check in check_approval_flag.py. Change the assertion in test_approval_migration_ratchet.py to use == instead of <=, and update test_contracts.py to match any modified limit.

root_causes.title: Truthiness Check Bypass in archive-stale-sessions.ts
root_causes.description: The check for --source-filter uses JavaScript truthiness. A whitespace-only string bypasses the deny-by-default --apply gate.
root_causes.solution_summary: Replace the truthiness check with an explicit check for non-empty and non-whitespace strings.

root_causes.title: Missing lock_file_path in Meta-lock LockUnavailableError and related write_utils bugs
root_causes.description: The LockUnavailableError raised for the meta-lock is missing the lock_file_path kwarg, breaking holder liveness introspection. Includes P2 bundle fixes for UnicodeDecodeError, Darwin ps command path, and start-time UTC fallback.
root_causes.solution_summary: Update the raise statement in write_utils.py to pass lock_file_path. Add UnicodeDecodeError to exception catching. Use /bin/ps and time.timezone for the Darwin fallback. Update tests to assert holder metadata propagation.

root_causes.title: Missing extract_frontmatter Tests
root_causes.description: extract_frontmatter has no unit tests to enforce its exact byte contract regarding CRLF and trailing newlines.
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a new parameterized test suite and update the function docstring.

root_causes.title: ADR Quality and Reference Updates
root_causes.description: Several ADRs are missing cross-references, alternative sections, and proper indexing as noted in retrospective reviews.
root_causes.solution_summary: Apply the markdown updates described in the issue text across the listed ADRs.

root_causes.title: Workflow Missing Environment and Concurrency Gates
root_causes.description: The jules-archive-stale.yml workflow lacks an environment approval gate and a concurrency block.
root_causes.solution_summary: Add environment: jules-archive-approval and a concurrency block to the archive job.

tasks.title: Fix check_approval_flag bugs
tasks.prompt:
Fix two related bugs in the approval-flag ratchet.

First, in `scripts/hooks/check_approval_flag.py`, the equals-form rejection runs *before* the `_EXEMPT_PATHS` check. After the `APPROVAL_EQUALS_REJECTION_DEADLINE` (2026-12-31), any edit to `scripts/_optional_surface_common.py` (which legitimately contains `--approval=`) will fail. Move the `_EXEMPT_PATHS` check to before the equals-form check.

Before:
```python
        if ( _contains_approval_equals(staged_text) and _migration_deadline_passed() ): ...
        if staged_path.path in _EXEMPT_PATHS:
            continue
```
After:
```python
        if staged_path.path in _EXEMPT_PATHS:
            continue
        if ( _contains_approval_equals(staged_text) and _migration_deadline_passed() ): ...
```

Second, in `tests/kb/test_approval_migration_ratchet.py`, `test_approval_flag_script_count_does_not_exceed_contract` uses `<=` for its assertion instead of `==`. This defeats the ratchet mechanism. Change `<=` to `==`.

Before:
`assert len(files) <= MAX_APPROVAL_FLAG_SCRIPTS`
After:
`assert len(files) == MAX_APPROVAL_FLAG_SCRIPTS`

Finally, update `test_approval_flag_ratchet_baseline_is_declared_and_exported` in `tests/kb/test_contracts.py` if `MAX_APPROVAL_FLAG_SCRIPTS` is modified during migration to reflect the tightened ratchet.

Acceptance criteria:
- The test assertion uses tight equality (`==`).
- The pre-commit exemption check runs before the equals-form rejection.
- You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.

tasks.title: Fix archive-stale-sessions truthiness
Fix LockUnavailableError and write bugs
tasks.prompt:
Fix multiple bugs in `scripts/kb/write_utils.py` and enhance its tests.

1. Meta-lock `LockUnavailableError` (Issue #302): In `_acquire_sibling_governance_lock`, the meta-lock acquisition failure raises `LockUnavailableError(contracts.GOVERNANCE_META_LOCK_PATH) from exc` but is missing the `lock_file_path=repo_root / contracts.GOVERNANCE_META_LOCK_PATH` kwarg. This causes holder introspection to fail. Pass this kwarg.

2. `UnicodeDecodeError` (Issue #305): `_read_lock_holder_details` does not catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. Add it to the exception block along with `OSError`.

3. Darwin start-time UTC fallback and ps path (Issues #305, #306): In `_darwin_pid_start_time_unix_seconds`, change `["ps", ...]` to `["/bin/ps", ...]`. For the timezone fallback, if `datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo` is None, instead of blindly falling back to UTC, use `time.timezone` (e.g. `import time; if time.timezone: return time.mktime(parsed.timetuple())`) to avoid shifting by the local UTC offset in the wrong direction.

In `tests/kb/test_write_utils.py`, extend both `test_customizations_lock_fails_when_sibling_governance_lock_is_held` and `test_sibling_governance_lock_fails_when_customizations_lock_is_held` to assert that `holder_alive` is True and `holder_context_hash` matches `r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"` on the resulting probe.

Acceptance criteria:
- Meta-lock raises LockUnavailableError with the proper path.
- UnicodeDecodeError is caught.
- Darwin ps uses full path and correct timezone handling.
- Tests assert holder metadata propagation.
- You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.

tasks.title: Add extract_frontmatter tests
tasks.prompt:
Add missing unit tests for `extract_frontmatter` to codify its byte contract, and update its docstring.

In `scripts/kb/page_template_utils.py`, update the docstring for `extract_frontmatter` to state that the original body bytes (including CRLF and trailing newlines) are preserved verbatim.

Create a new test file `tests/kb/test_extract_frontmatter.py` containing parameterized tests for `extract_frontmatter` covering:
- Happy LF (`---
fm
---
body
`)
- Happy CRLF (`---
fm
---
body
`)
- Leading whitespace before opening delim (`  ---
fm
---
body`)
- Empty frontmatter (`---
---
body
`)
- No frontmatter pass-through (`no frontmatter
`)
- Unclosed delim (`---
unclosed
body
`)
- `---` mid-body (`---
fm
---
body
---
more
`)
- File ending at closing delim (`---
fm
---`)

Each case must explicitly assert both the `fm` and `body` returns to verify the byte contract.

Acceptance criteria:
- The docstring is updated.
- The new test file exists with at least 8 parameterized cases testing both returns.
- You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.

tasks.title: Fix workflow gates
tasks.prompt:
Add missing deployment and concurrency controls to the destructive archive workflow.

In `.github/workflows/jules-archive-stale.yml`, modify the `archive` job to include an `environment` and `concurrency` block to prevent unauthorized runs and race conditions.

Before:
```yaml
jobs:
  archive:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
```
After:
```yaml
jobs:
  archive:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: jules-archive-approval
    concurrency:
      group: jules-archive-stale
      cancel-in-progress: false
    timeout-minutes: 10
```

Acceptance criteria:
- The workflow file contains both the `environment` and `concurrency` blocks.
- You may ONLY modify the files listed above. If a test file outside your boundary fails, you must make your source changes backward-compatible so the existing test passes unmodified. Do NOT rename, move, or delete any files outside your boundary.
